name: Lorcaserin
summary: Lorcaserin, sold under the brand name Belviq, is a weight-loss drug that was developed by Arena Pharmaceuticals. It reduces appetite by activating the 5-HT2C serotonin receptor in the hypothalamus, a region of the brain which is known to control appetite. It was approved in 2012, and in 2020 was removed from the market in the United States due to an increased risk of cancer detected in users of Belviq.

pharmacology.text: Lorcaserin is a selective 5-HT2C receptor agonist, and in vitro testing of the drug showed reasonable selectivity for 5-HT2C over other related targets. 5-HT2C receptors are located almost exclusively in the brain, and can be found in the choroid plexus, cortex, hippocampus, cerebellum, amygdala, thalamus, and hypothalamus.

uses.text: Lorcaserin was used long term for weight loss in those who are obese.

sideEffects.text: FDA required a post-marketing cardiovascular safety trial as a condition of lorcaserin's approval (a requirement for all weight management drugs since the withdrawal of sibutramine in 2010 due to cardiovascular harm).

zhOther: 洛卡色林, 綠卡色林
summaryZh: 氯卡色林（英語：Lorcaserin，商品名Belviq），又名洛卡色林、綠卡色林，是由阿里那製藥公司研發的一種減肥藥。它通過激活下視丘中控制食慾的5-羥色胺2C受體來抑制食慾。
